text.description_html:
Laurey 39521, Rustic Midtown Cabinet Pull in Matte Black with a Terra Cotta Wash

The Matte Black Midtown Cabinet Pull with a Terra Cotta Wash not only has a unique style, it also has a unique finish. Well-suited to rustic and tuscan home decor designs, the Midtown Cabinet Pull in Matte Black with a Terra Cotta Wash is sure to represent your style. The Midtown Cabinet Pull has a 3 inch center to center and is 4 inches overall.

This cabinet pull is part of the Laurey Midtown Collection.

Specifications and Features of the Laurey 39521 3 Inch Midtown Pull Iron Black and Terra Cotta:

  • Material: Zinc
  • Finish: Matte Black with a Terra Cotta Wash
  • Length c.c. (center to center): 3"
  • Overall Length: 4"
  • Width: 3/4"
  • Projection: 1-1/4"
  • Packaged with 1" long #8-32 screws and 1-1/2" long #8-32 screws.

Available finishes:
Matte Black / Terra Cotta Wash Satin Nickel

Sold Individually
